skills: Hold with 30+ Solar Prominence: up to 4 hits for massive Ether DMG, each costing some. Switching out during the 3rd lets him finish the 4th off-field.
Spinning Ether slash; with 30+ Solar Prominence, hold to go into the 3rd Celestial Light hit.
Ether combo; same Celestial Light follow-up.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Ether thrust; same Celestial Light follow-up.
Charge and combo for massive Ether DMG. Getting hit during the charge is a Perfect Block: no DMG and the move's Interrupt Level rises to a heavy Defensive Assist's. Same Celestial Light follow-up.
His Ultimate or Sun's Halo calls in Phaethon for an Ether assist attack (once per 2.5s; always on Ultimate).
Joint attack with Phaethon for massive Ether DMG; same Celestial Light follow-up.

Costs only 2,000 Decibels and always calls in Phaethon (Assault Directive). Pick one of four branches by direction; each deals massive Ether DMG and leads into a Celestial Light follow-up. Usual plan: Lower to open the fight, then in each Stun go in with Decibels for two: Upper first, Right last.

skills.name: Triumphant Return
skills.what: An energy burst that puts him in Sunflare for 200s: +15% Energy Generation, more DMG (up to +40% at Core Skill F), and EX Special Attack Perfect Blocks give 10 Solar Prominence.
skills.best: Open every fight with it. It lasts the whole battle, so once is usually enough. At Mindscape 1 he starts with enough Decibels to use it right away; at Mindscape 2 it gives back 1,500 Decibels.

skills.name: Total Annihilation
skills.what: A charged slash. Gives 30 Solar Prominence and Mirage for 21s: his Ultimates deal +40% CRIT DMG to Stunned enemies, and holding on the 4th Celestial Light hit loops back to the 3rd.
skills.best: Right as an enemy is Stunned, to start the Stun window with the CRIT DMG buff and Solar Prominence for Celestial Light.

skills.name: Eternal Imprisonment
skills.what: Gathers enemies and ends with a finisher. On Stunned enemies its heavy hits Totalize for extra DMG (up to 2,250% ATK) and add 3s to the Stun, then the finisher ends the Stun.
skills.best: At the very end of a Stun window, after Total Annihilation. It’s his strongest Ultimate: if you can afford only one in a Stun, pick this one. Don’t use it early, since it ends the Stun.

skills.name: Unbound Swordstorm
skills.what: A combo. On Contaminated enemies its heavy hits add up to 900% ATK as extra DMG.
skills.best: Only when enemies are Contaminated: a Wind Agent on the team, or a boss that gets Windswept by itself. Otherwise save the Decibels for Lower or Right.

core.name: Radiant Chariot
core.text:
Enters battle with 30 Solar Prominence (once per 180s in Investigation Zones); his hits add more, plus 0.5 per second (max 60).
Upper (Total Annihilation): +30 Solar Prominence and Mirage for 21s: Ultimate +40% CRIT DMG on Stunned enemies, and holding on the 4th Celestial Light hit loops back to the 3rd.
Lower (Triumphant Return): Sunflare for 200s: +15% Energy Generation, +{0}% DMG, and EX Perfect Blocks give 10 Solar Prominence.
Left (Unbound Swordstorm): heavy hits on Contaminated enemies add {1}% ATK as DMG.
Right (Eternal Imprisonment): heavy hits on Stunned enemies Totalize for {2}% ATK as extra DMG; extends current Stuns by 3s, and the finisher ends the Stun.

ability.name: Glorious Legion
ability.text: Raises his CRIT DMG, and his Chain Attacks give Decibels. (The wiki doesn't list the exact numbers yet.)

mindscapes: Enters battle with 1,000 Decibels (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). +8% CRIT Rate.
Triumphant Return gives 1,500 Decibels (once per 180s). Decibel cap +1,000.
A Sun's Halo Perfect Block gives a Shield of 8% Max HP for 10s; +10% Daze while shielded.

rotations.title: Stun window with Dialyn
rotations.before: Open the fight with Triumphant Return (Lower) so Sunflare is up the whole battle.

steps.note: Build Daze until the enemy is Stunned.

steps.name: Total Annihilation
steps.note: Cancel the Chain Attack into Dialyn’s free Ultimate.

steps.name: Total Annihilation
steps.note: Again: it gives back the Solar Prominence for another held Basic.

steps.name: Celestial Light · Sun’s Halo
steps.note: Spend every hold Basic and EX Special you have left.

steps.name: Eternal Imprisonment
steps.note: At the very last second of the Stun, since it ends the Stun.

rotations.why: Total Annihilation gives 30 Solar Prominence, so using it twice lets you fit three held Basics into one Stun instead of two.
